integrity: All proof claims are accompanied by explicit derivations; accompanying exact-arithmetic verifier covers stated finite ranges. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic nonnegative integral degree vectors with total n and a one-unit smoothing transfer. General random mixtures and independent-target weighted mappings are outside scope. Baseline cyclic-count formula is prior work; residual historical implicit coverage remains possible. Finite enumeration does not prove all-size claims.
title: Single-crossing laws and sharp total-variation responses to balancing in-degrees of random mappings
